description: This file defines Java and Python streaming listener interfaces and related data classes for Spark Streaming, including event handling, batch info, receiver info, and output operation info.

classes.name: PythonStreamingListener
classes.description: Trait for Python streaming event callbacks.

classes.name: PythonStreamingListenerWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class to adapt PythonStreamingListener to JavaStreamingListener.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListener
classes.description: Java interface for receiving streaming events.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerBatchSubmitted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has been submitted.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerBatchCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has completed.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerBatchStarted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has started.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerOutputOperationStarted
classes.description: Event indicating an output operation has started.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerOutputOperationCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating an output operation has completed.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerReceiverStarted
classes.description: Event indicating a receiver has started.

classes.name: JavaStreamingListenerReceiverStopped
classes.description: Event indicating a receiver has stopped.

classes.name: JavaBatchInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a batch, including timing, input info, and output info.

classes.name: JavaStreamInputInfo
classes.description: Tracks input stream info for a batch.

classes.name: JavaOutputOperationInfo
classes.description: Contains info about an output operation.
